points.batteryMarkerTip: Voltage this point needs (selected mode), against the pack window.

thermal.title: Thermal
thermal.limitLine: S1 continuous limit ({day}): winding {winding} °C at the limit

thermal.limitTip: State of the limit search (S1), not the temperature of this duty.

tileTip.torqueActiveMass: Torque per active mass (EM parts), not the whole motor.
tileTip.emTorque: Torque the coupled loop ended on, at its own temperatures. The torque tile in the EM block is the EM run's.
tileTip.winding: Settled winding temperature of this point (coupled loop).
tileTip.housing: Housing temperature, where the thermal map states it.
tileTip.bearing: Bearing temperature of the coupled loop.
tileTip.s1: Largest current the motor holds for ever at this point's cooling (S1).
tileTip.s2: Time this point may run before a part reaches its limit (S2).

thermal.s1Tip: Largest continuous current; the limit sits in the {part}.
thermal.s2Tip: Time to the limit of the {part}.
